Seems the retryable requests file covers more ops: 1.814 > 1.811

From my investigation, during RBS, seems it's possible that the last wal segment containing more ops is not synced to disk before the remote peer downloading it.

Delay is injected before UpdateSegmentReadableOffset(); Latest data is not sent to the remote peer
